title: Library
description: Creates a workspace library with the tags, targets, README and @app/* path alias the workspace rules expect.

name.description: Project name, kebab-case. It is also the directory name.

runtime.description: Runtime tag (runtime:<value>). Defaults to the layer's usual runtime.

directory.description: Parent directory. Defaults to the layer's directory (for example libs/engine for services).

description.description: One or two sentences for the README purpose section.

trustCritical.description: Adds trust:critical: the paths need human CODEOWNERS sign-off.
